intro: Emergency Alert Tuesday! The nationwide test came and went, and our guy had the best take on it: his phone did blow up, but it was a margin call, not FEMA. Add in futures lambo shopping, a heartfelt -50% promise, and some Herb Alpert Christmas vibes, and this was a broadcast worth tuning in for!

items.caption: The joke of the day, no contest. Phone blowing up during the national alert test? Nope, just the broker checking in. 6 likes for this masterpiece!
items.quote: $SPY My phone started blowing up and I thought it was the national emergency alert test but it was just a Charles Schwab Margin call.

items.caption: Meanwhile on X, he's out here asking the real question: was the big nationwide test even audible? Relatable king!
items.quote: Did I totally miss the nation wide test emergency alert? Was I supposed to notice something?

items.caption: Follow-up review of the alert test, delivered to @BrockCheddar with a verdict: underwhelming. The critic has spoken!
items.quote: @BrockCheddar oh well that's not much of a test lol

items.caption: The most sincere trader pledge ever written. Just a little bounce back to -50%, and then he's a changed man. 8 likes, the top post of the day!
items.quote: $SPY Just let me get back to -50% and I won’t gamble any more fam.

items.caption: Evening futures check: green enough that they're browsing lambos. The lambo saga continues!
Holiday season is officially open: he's already spinning Herb Alpert & the Tijuana Brass Christmas. Classy taste, as always!
items.quote: @Shermantor Already listening to my Herb Alpert and the TJB Christmas album

items.caption: Sharing a clip from @cosyposter with a stamp of approval. When he says someone was "so real for this," you know it's good!
items.quote: He was so real for this. . .
